evidence-integrity.command:
python3 docs/evidence/base-ui-migration/p2.2/run-check.py evidence-integrity python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path('docs/evidence/base-ui-migration/p2.2')
counts={'full-matrix':208,'final-surfaces':64,'submenu-repeat':10,'overlay-regressions':96}
checked=0
for directory,count in counts.items():
    folder=root/directory
    summary=json.loads((folder/'summary.json').read_text())
    stats=summary['stats']
    assert stats['expected']==count and stats['unexpected']==stats['skipped']==stats['flaky']==0
    for test in summary['tests']:
        for artifact in test['artifacts']:
            assert hashlib.sha256((folder/artifact['file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==artifact['sha256']
            checked+=1
baseline='67e62c0b4028eefe2c619dac80d3fac312cea601'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff',baseline,'--','docs/evidence/base-ui-migration/p0.2'])
source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert source_commit=='1a70fbb902d6b24453a57994f782a40546d67c94'
latest=json.loads((root/'checks/final-surfaces-and-navigation.json').read_text())
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',baseline,source_commit],text=True).splitlines()
for name in files:
    if name in latest['sourceHashes']:
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==latest['sourceHashes'][name],name
print(json.dumps({'sourceCommit':source_commit,'passedRuns':counts,'artifactsVerified':checked,'finalSourceHashesMatch':True,'historicalP0Unchanged':True}))
PY
